caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, reflective lidded goblet or urn positioned centrally on the page. The object has a wide, rounded body with a slightly outward-flaring rim, resting on a short, thick stem and a circular, ornamented base. The lid is domed, topped with a finial that has a curved, flag-like form. Reflections and highlights are evident on the surface, suggesting a polished metal material. The drawing is executed in black graphite or pencil on an off-white or light beige paper, with fine shading used to represent the shiny, reflective quality and subtle details of the object’s form. The object is contained within a rectangular border centered on the page, and there are no additional objects or background elements present.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl with Cover
